title: A Stranger Texted Me That My Dog Was Sleeping on Her Porch #shorts #textstory
description:
I don't have a dog. His tag says otherwise.

Follow for new stories every day.

#textstory #shorts #wholesome #dogs

messages.text: Your dog has slept on my porch for three nights.
His tag has this number on it. His name is Pickles.
I only got this number two weeks ago.
Well, Pickles thinks you're his person.
Vet says he's fourteen. His chip says Walter.
I did. Walter passed away last month.
His daughter says Pickles ran off after the funeral.
She lives overseas. She can't take him.
He's in my car. He put his head on my shoulder.
I'm keeping this number. In case he calls it again.

end: Pickles kept calling Walter's number. Someone finally answered.
